generation_prompt: After a person slides the white clock closer, the robot grasps its casing with its left hand and lifts it from the table. The left hand carries the clock to the wooden shelf and lowers it upright into the upper tray beside the banana, then begins opening its fingers while remaining over the clock. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: White clock upright inside upper wooden tray beside banana, partly behind front rim. Left hand stays over it and has begun opening its opposing digit; right hand remains open near basket. Final independent stability and complete loss of all hand contact are not directly visible.

arm_hand_roles.left: Sole manipulator: reaches, encloses clock casing, lifts and carries clock to upper shelf tray, lowers it and begins opening fingers.
arm_hand_roles.right: Open beside the apple/basket throughout; minor posture movement, no grasp, support, or transfer.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-handed transport and placement. Person repositions clock before robot grasps it; no hand-to-hand object transfer or two-hand robot coordination.

uncertainties: Tray rim and left hand hide the exact clock base contact and rear finger contact. Opening is visible, but complete release and stable unsupported placement after withdrawal cannot be verified before the ending.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
